title: CaseBook case import (v1)
description: A structured document that seeds a new or existing CaseBook case with a summary, timeline entries, entities/IOCs and action items. Imported as a human-confirmed draft.

origin.description: Provenance recorded as the source of imported indicators and timeline entries (e.g. "AI-assisted (Copilot)", "manual", "XSIAM").

summary.description: A narrative summary of the matter, imported as an analyst note.

target.description: Where the import lands: an existing case (by id) or a new one.

caseId.description: Import into this existing case (takes precedence over newCase when visible).

newCase.description: Opening fields for a new case.

descriptiveName.description: Optional short slug source; derived from the title when omitted.

classification.description: Omit or "ComplexEvent" files an intake Complex Event.

summary.description: The case's own summary field (distinct from the top-level summary note).

detectedAtUtc.description: When the matter was detected (defaults to now; not in the future).

occurredAtUtc.description: When activity began (must not be after detection).

dataTypesInvolved.description: Free-text data context (notes). Regulated data elements are recorded in the impact assessment, not here.

detectionCaseId.description: The source platform's id for the event, e.g. the XSIAM incident id (the case's detection-source back-link). Up to 100 characters.

occurredAtUtc.description: When it happened (defaults to now if omitted; future entries are excluded). With timePrecision Day or OnOrBefore, the date; with Window, the first date.

timePrecision.description: For kind Event: how precisely the time was stated. Exact (default), Day (date only), Window (between occurredAtUtc and occurredUntilUtc), OnOrBefore (on or before occurredAtUtc's date), NotStated (no time; placed after the step before it).

occurredUntilUtc.description: For timePrecision Window: the last date.

source.description: Optional origin of this entry (defaults to the document origin).

rationale.description: For type Decision: why it was decided (required for a decision). Ignored for other types.

optionsConsidered.description: For type Decision: the other options considered. Optional.

decidedBy.description: For type Decision: who made the decision, e.g. "Incident Commander with Legal". Optional.

type.description: Optional — auto-detected from the value when omitted.

value.description: The indicator; defanged notation (hxxp://, 1.1.1[.]1) is accepted and refanged.
